control_detail: English over LP2's real layout, 2 layouts x 20 variants per regime, through words.py: regime a (true spaces in order) W1-W4 pages recognised 1760/1760 (Wilson 0.998-1.0; exact recovery and pmax > P null max 5.591); regime b (words shuffled within sentence) 1760/1760. coverage: 20 variants x 55 pages + 20 whole-stream decodes on the 2,896-word segmentation (page-wrap word belongs to the page it starts on).
